## Bio & Overview
Aryan Kaushik is a Protocol Engineer and Python Systems Developer based in New Delhi, India. He holds a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Amity University (8.03 CGPA) and is currently pursuing a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies (VIPS) with an 8.5 CGPA.

Aryan specializes in Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) architecture, smart contract security, gas optimization techniques, and high-performance Python backend systems. He is currently working as a Software Engineer Intern at IRC ENGINEERING SERVICES (I) PVT LTD in Noida, India, where he develops AI-driven software solutions and backend tools for Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) workflows.

## Research & Publications
### 1. Reactive Governance: A Selective Snapshotting Framework for Secure and Gas-Efficient DAO Voting (2026)
- **Publisher**: Zenodo (Preprint 2026, DOI: 20037058)
- **Abstract**: Introduces a novel selective snapshotting protocol for DAO governance on Ethereum-compatible blockchains. Standard governance tokens suffer from high gas overhead because every transfer requires updating historical voting checkpoints (`ERC20Votes`). Reactive Governance defers voting power calculations, reducing transfer gas costs by up to 40% while maintaining formal security guarantees against late-stake and flash loan manipulation.
- **Key Metric**: ~17,715 gas marginal cost per snapshot.

### 2. Plant Disease Recognition: Integrating Deep Learning for Accurate Diagnosis and Sustainable Agriculture
- **Publisher**: IEEE Conference Proceedings
- **Abstract**: Explores deep learning architectures applied to early-stage plant pathology detection. Demonstrates convolutional network training, image augmentation, and automated diagnostic workflows for sustainable farming.
